name: venue-booking
description: Campus venue-booking system — npm workspaces monorepo (client, server, shared).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=client && npm run lint --workspace=server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=client && npm run test --workspace=server
